Class ViewGUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.ViewGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserInterface
public class ViewGUI extends Object implements UserInterface
JavaFX implementation of UserInterface that bridges incoming server notifications with the GUI layer.

ViewGUI acts as the single entry point through which the Client pushes game-state updates to the interface. Every method delegates to the appropriate JavaFX scene controller (GameController, MainMenuController, or LeaderboardController) by dispatching work onto the JavaFX Application Thread via Platform.runLater(Runnable). Controller references are volatile so that assignments made on the FX thread are immediately visible to the network thread that calls these methods.

The singleton field gui gives other GUI components quick access to the active instance without dependency injection.

Methods that are meaningful only in the TUI (start(), displayHelpMessage(), info(int), showStatusScreen(), showCompletedDraw()) are intentionally left as no-ops.

    • boardSyncedAfterReconnect

    • onEvent

      public void onEvent(EventDTO events, List<PlayerStatsDTO> statsBefore)
      Notifies the game scene that one or more event cards have been resolved.

      EventDTO carries both the list of triggered event cards and the resulting per-player stats, while statsBefore provides a snapshot of stats prior to the event so the UI can animate the delta.

      Specified by:
      onEvent in interface UserInterface
      Parameters:
      events - the EventDTO containing triggered cards and post-event player stats
      statsBefore - the list of PlayerStatsDTO captured immediately before the events were applied

    • onGameEnding

      public void onGameEnding(List<PlayerStatsDTO> stats, int rankingPos, int globalRankingPos)
      Triggers the end-game screen with the final rankings.

      If the event banner is currently being displayed (e.g. an event animation is still running), the call is retried after a 500 ms PauseTransition to avoid overlapping UI transitions.

      Specified by:
      onGameEnding in interface UserInterface
      Parameters:
      stats - final PlayerStatsDTO list for all players
      rankingPos - this player's position in the match-specific ranking
      globalRankingPos - this player's position in the global leaderboard

    • quit

      public VirtualModel quit()
      Tears down the GUI's game state and resets the VirtualModel.

      Called by the RMI client during its teardown sequence. No UI work is needed here; the model is managed by the caller. The method returns the model so the caller can re-use or discard it.

      Specified by:
      quit in interface UserInterface
      Returns:
      the current VirtualModel, after VirtualModel.reset() has been called; may be null if none was set
